data.title: Senior Automation Engineer
data.summary: Lead the control architecture and commissioning of brownfield automation projects across the Eastern Seaboard.
data.description: You will own the technical shape of automation projects from survey to handover, working closely with plant teams and vendors. This is a hands-on role: design reviews, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, and the difficult conversations that make a system reliable.
responsibilities: Define PLC, safety, and network architectures for multi-vendor projects.
Lead factory acceptance testing and staged commissioning.
Review vendor designs and protect the integrity of the agreed interface.
Mentor junior engineers and technicians on live sites.
Document decisions, assumptions, and residual risks.
requirements: 6+ years in industrial automation or controls engineering.
Strong PLC and HMI experience across at least two platforms.
Working knowledge of functional safety and machine guarding.
Comfortable working in active production environments.
